test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

"I am playing the keyboard," she explained.

options.text: She explained that she was playing the keyboard.
She said that she is playing the keyboard.
She said that she had been playing the keyboard.
She explained that she is playing the keyboard

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She explained that she was playing the keyboard.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **Pronoun:**
 
 
• In direct speech, the pronoun "I" is changed to "she" to match the subject of the reporting verb.
 
 
 
• **Tense:**
 
 
• The present continuous tense "am playing" is converted to the past continuous tense "was playing" in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• The reporting verb "explained" indicates a statement providing clarification, which remains unchanged.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted into a subordinate clause introduced by "that."
 
• Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She explained that she was playing the keyboard."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "She said that she is playing the keyboard." – Incorrect tense (present continuous instead of past continuous).
 
• **Option 3:** "She said that she had been playing the keyboard." – Incorrect tense (past perfect continuous instead of past continuous).
 
• **Option 4:** "She explained that she is playing the keyboard." – Incorrect tense (present continuous instead of past continuous).
